items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I heard Duke around Washington... I heard a lot of Duke around Washington

ctx.x: Well, I heard Duke around Washington. You know, I told you I left that school, and I went around Washington, and I heard Duke around there because he played there quite often. So --
MS WILLARD: He had already gone to New York for several years.

Oh, yeah, this is around '29-30 and around in there when I heard a lot of Duke around Washington, because there's a place he used to come and play dances all the time, the Lincoln Colonnade. And you know, it was right next to the Lincoln Theater. This guy Al Leachman owned the Lincoln Theater, and right next door was the Lincoln Colonnade, and most all the big bands used to come there and play dances.
